name: Proventus Agrocom Ltd.
summary: Proventus Agrocom Ltd. is an integrated health-food company specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of dry fruits, nuts, seeds, and berries. The company operates within the healthy snacking segment, following a "farm-to-fork" model that encompasses global origination, processing in its integrated facilities, and retail branding under its "ProV" brand. Its product portfolio includes a diversified range of almonds, cashews, walnuts, pistachios, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, and various berries, along with wholesome nutrition-based products such as flavored makhana, healthy bars, trail mixes, and nut chocolates. Proventus Agrocom primarily targets the consumer retail (B2C) and wholesale (B2B) segments within the Indian domestic market, distributing its products through modern trade, e-commerce, general trade, and a direct-to-consumer network.
